title: Clinical Research & Regulatory Affairs Manager
description: Manage clinical trial protocols, biotech R&D projects, pharmaceutical regulatory documentation, and healthcare device compliance.
details:
### Role Overview
Lead clinical trials, pharmaceutical compliance, and biotech R&D project lifecycles within top-tier healthcare and drug manufacturing firms.

### Key Responsibilities
- Oversee Phase I–IV clinical trial protocols, GCP compliance, and IRB/regulatory submissions.
- Coordinate drug safety monitoring, pharmacovigilance, and medical device audit documentation.
- Manage relationships with clinical research organizations (CROs) and principal investigators.

### Requirements
- M.Pharm, Master's in Biotechnology, or Ph.D. in Life Sciences.
- 5+ years of experience in clinical trial management or pharmaceutical regulatory affairs.
